description: This file defines the authentication context for a React application, including a context provider, custom hooks, and methods to handle user sign-in, sign-out, and session management using Supabase.

methods.name: AuthProvider
methods.description: React functional component that provides authentication context, managing user session and auth state.

methods.name: useAuth
methods.description: Custom hook to access authentication context. Throws error if used outside of AuthProvider.

methods.name: useRole
methods.description: Hook that derives the user's role from session metadata.

methods.name: useSupabaseAuth
methods.description: Alias for useAuth, maintained for backward compatibility.
